description: The code graph is always built and fresh, and hexa do gate runs where the tests run

accepted.by: gary (standing instruction: always accept the ADRs and specs; recorded by the implementing agent, builder B, 2026-11-22)

specs.description: The graph reads the project's files and no nested worktree's
specs.given: a git checkout with `src/a.rs` and a nested worktree `origin/t3/x/` (a directory holding a `.git` file) that holds `src/b.rs`
specs.then: the graph holds a node for `src/a.rs` and none whose source file is under `origin/`

specs.description: A gitignored file is not read
specs.given: a git checkout whose `.gitignore` names `gen/`, with `gen/big.rs` and a tracked `src/a.rs`
specs.then: the graph holds `src/a.rs` and no node from `gen/big.rs`

specs.description: A build records a stamp with its fingerprint
specs.given: a git checkout with one source file
specs.then: `.hexa/graph/stamp.json` holds `built_at`, `nodes` (the graph's node count) and a 64-hex `fingerprint`

specs.description: A deleted file changes the fingerprint though no file is newer
specs.when: `src/b.rs` is deleted and `hexa graph status --json` runs
specs.then: the state is `stale`, though no remaining file is newer than the graph

specs.description: Status reports missing, then fresh, then stale after an edit
specs.given: a git checkout with one source file and no graph
specs.when: `hexa graph status --json` runs before a build, after a build, and after an edit to the file
specs.then: the states are `missing`, `fresh` (with `built` true and `nodes` above 0) and `stale` (with `changed` at least 1), and each run exits 0

specs.description: A graph with no stamp is stale, not fresh
specs.given: a graph file written without a stamp (a build by an older hexa)
specs.then: the state is `stale` and `built` is true
it exits 0, `.hexa/graph/graph.json` exists, and `hexa graph status --json` says `fresh`

specs.description: The graph init builds holds nothing init wrote under `.claude/`
specs.then: the graph holds no node whose source file is under `.claude/` or `.hexa/`

specs.description: SessionStart rebuilds a stale graph in the background
specs.given: a hexa project with a built graph and a source file edited since
specs.then: it prints a `graph:` line naming the stale state, returns without waiting, and within 60 seconds the status is `fresh` again

specs.description: SessionStart leaves a fresh graph alone
specs.given: a hexa project with a fresh graph
specs.then: it prints `graph: fresh` and the stamp's `built_at` is unchanged after 3 seconds

specs.description: The edit hook prints the file's graph context, bounded
specs.given: a hexa project with a built graph where `src/b.rs` imports `src/a.rs`
specs.when: `hexa hook pre-edit` runs for an edit to `src/a.rs`
specs.then: it exits 0 and prints at most 12 graph lines that name `src/a.rs` and its consumer `src/b.rs`; a second edit to the same file in the same session prints no graph lines

specs.description: With no graph, or for a file the graph does not hold, the edit hook prints no context and does not block
specs.given: a hexa project with no graph; then the same project with a built graph and a new file `src/new.rs` the graph does not hold
specs.when: `hexa hook pre-edit` runs for an edit to `src/a.rs` with no graph, then for `src/new.rs` and `src/b.rs` with the graph
specs.then: it exits 0 and prints no graph line with no graph and for `src/new.rs`; the control, `src/b.rs`, does get its context

specs.description: A remote `do gate` commits the commit the runner tested, on exit 0
specs.given: a project whose `test.remote` runs the gate in a clone of the pushed commit, on a branch, with a change to `src/a.rs`
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files src/a.rs -e 'bash ci/ok.sh' -m fix --no-land` runs without `--local`
specs.then: it exits 0; the branch's new HEAD is the commit the runner printed; that commit holds the change; the branch is pushed to origin at that commit; no `hexa-gate/` ref is left on origin; the commit's `refs/notes/hexa-gate` note holds the runner's output

specs.description: A remote `do gate` whose gate fails commits nothing
specs.given: the same project with a gate that exits 1 on the remote
specs.then: it exits non-zero; HEAD has not moved; the change is still in the tree; no `hexa-gate/` ref is left on origin; nothing ran the gate locally

specs.description: A sealed test whose amendment was recorded is committed through the gate
specs.given: an accepted spec with a sealed test `tests/t.sh`, edited and recorded with `hexa spec amend … --confirm <sha256>`
specs.when: `hexa do gate --local --files tests/t.sh <the spec record> -e 'bash tests/t.sh'` runs
specs.then: it exits 0 and commits both the test and the spec record

specs.description: An unrecorded edit to a sealed test is still refused
specs.given: the sealed test edited with no amendment recorded; then an amendment recorded for that content and the file edited again
specs.when: `hexa do gate --local --files tests/t.sh <the spec record> -e 'bash tests/t.sh'` runs after each
specs.then: both runs exit non-zero naming the sealed file and commit nothing; the control, the file put back to the recorded content, passes

specs.description: Under test.remote the commit hook's refusal names the remote gate
specs.given: a project with `test.remote` and lifecycle enforcement mandatory, with a staged change to `src/a.rs`
specs.then: it refuses, naming `hexa do gate` and saying the gate runs on the remote runner

specs.description: Without test.remote the refusal does not mention a remote runner
specs.then: it refuses naming `hexa do gate`, and says nothing of a remote runner; the control, the same project with `test.remote` set, does
